requirements.text: Credits are granted from purchase or plan events, once per idempotency key, optionally with an expiry
Each usage event debits once per key; retries never charge twice and a changed amount under the same key fails
The balance never goes negative, including under concurrent debits
Long-running work reserves credits, captures the amount used and returns the rest; abandoned holds expire
Expiring credits are spent first and forfeited after expiry
Every change is an append-only ledger entry the account admin can review
Usage is aggregated per billing period and reported to the billing provider for invoicing or top-ups

evidence.name: retries never charge twice and balances never go negative
a store that keeps losing the race surfaces a conflict
holds reserve credits, capture charges part and returns the rest
expiring grants are consumed first and forfeited after expiry

implementations.notes: Concurrency is tested against the in-memory store only; there is no SQL credit store and no history API
